name: Rocket Car Parts
summary: Across the Shimmering Flats, Rocket Car Parts lie scattered after mishaps at the Mirage Raceway. Gnome and goblin racers push their experimental speeders hard, and merchants gather wreckage to sell back to the teams.

sections.title: Speed, Wrecks, and Shrewd Commerce
sections.body:
At the Mirage Raceway in the Shimmering Flats, gnome and goblin engineers compete fiercely. Their racers chase greater speed on land. Breakdowns, misfires, and crashes scatter metal across the salt flats, where scavengers and merchants soon gather what remains.

The dwarf Kravel Koalbeard hires travelers to search the bright expanse and collect the debris. Both racing teams need spare machinery for their next prototypes, so wreckage can return to the teams whose cars left it behind.

faq.q: Where do all these rocket car parts come from?
aliases: why are there parts on the salt flats
where do the parts come from
faq.answer: Rocket Car Parts come from crashes, explosions, and mechanical failures at the Mirage Raceway. Gnome and goblin racers push experimental rocket-powered vehicles across the Thousand Needles salt flats until the cars break apart.

Merchants such as the dwarf Kravel Koalbeard buy wreckage gathered by travelers. They sell gears, plating, and other parts back to gnomes and goblins, who need materials to repair and improve their racing cars.

faq.q: Are the parts dangerous to scavenge?
aliases: is it safe to pick up parts
faq.answer: The wreckage itself is inert, though metal may bear grim signs of crashes, including severed appendages caught in it. Basilisks, scorched scorpids, and predatory salt vultures prowl the salt flats near the debris.

faq.q: Do the gnomes and goblins care that the parts are from crashed cars?
faq.answer: Gnome and goblin racers readily use recycled parts. They want workable machinery, gears, and plating to build cars fast enough to outrun each other on the track.

angles.text: Burnt gears and mangled exhaust assemblies litter the salt flats, reminders of the extremes gnome and goblin engineers reach.
Gnomes and goblins focus on the race, while dwarves such as Kravel Koalbeard can profit by scavenging the wreckage left behind.
